LanguageData.FH_Berserk.label: flesh berserk
LanguageData.FH_Berserk.description: The flesh beasts are driven into a frenzied berserk state.
LanguageData.FH_Berserk.stages.berserk.label: berserk
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Furiousmeld.label: furiousmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Furiousmeld.description:
This creature is parasitized by a furiousmeld. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host gains twisted flesh capacity, stronger armor, and regeneration.

-Shield-claw tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Bastionmeld.label: bastionmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Bastionmeld.description: This creature is parasitized by a bastionmeld. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nTwo parasitic weapon mounts are grafted onto the body, allowing the host to release an EMP pulse.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fissionmeld.label: fissionmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fissionmeld.description:
This creature is parasitized by a fissionmeld. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host's twisted flesh capacity and regeneration are increased; flesh undying is sustained while enough twisted flesh is stored, and harmful conditions can be purged.

-Motherbeast tentacle
LanguageData.FH_FleshUndying.label: flesh undying
LanguageData.FH_FleshUndying.description: Stored twisted flesh keeps the host from dying while the parasite rebuilds ruined tissue.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Dreadmeld.label: dreadmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Dreadmeld.description:
This creature is parasitized by a dreadmeld. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host gains incredible regeneration, improved mining work, and a terror roar.

-Motherbeast tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Nexusmeld.label: nexusmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Nexusmeld.description:
This creature is parasitized by a nexusmeld. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.

The host gains twisted flesh capacity and regeneration, and strengthens all friendly fleshbeasts.

-Motherbeast tentacle
LanguageData.FH_Unification.label: flesh unification
LanguageData.FH_Unification.description: The nexusmeld's psychic unity strengthens the flesh. Melee damage increased, incoming damage reduced.
